title: luzula campestris subvar. pallescens

It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Western Asia, and is known for its unique pale green or yellowish-green leaves and stems. The pale woodrush has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues due to its prebiotic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
